value.rationale: The lowest-degree coefficient measures degeneracy of the most economical Italian defense: a natural exact invariant explicitly motivated by the source polynomial. The all-order classification establishes a sharp parity contrast and isolated nonbinary six-vertex exception, replacing isolated small-order coefficient tables with a structural answer. This is useful when studying extremal coefficients and families of all minimizers; does not require general tree consequences.
